decisions.reason: The candidate already has a message-210 MODIFY that includes step-by-step guidance for viewing or converting prize funds, so no additional or corrected Event is needed.
Winner-guidance email contents do not change the email authentication method or dashboard-access behavior.
The emailed winner guidance is transactional-email behavior and does not require a change to the landing-page content or layout state.
The winner-guidance email decision does not affect whether or where the book cover appears on the landing page.
Guidance delivered after a prize win does not change SIWE support, protected flows, or wallet-authentication coverage.
The transactional winner-guidance email has no effect on authentication requirements or information exposed by public APIs.
The source requires emailed guidance for winners but does not require that guidance or its exchange link to be added to the About page.
Post-win email guidance for viewing or converting funds does not change Transak minting, wallet provisioning, payment methods, or the deferred lifecycle status.
The winner-guidance email is unrelated to the PDF.js reader engine and its dashboard or email-linked entry points.
The candidate already requires automatic wallet transfer; adding explanatory email guidance does not change the payout mode or reintroduce a claim control.
Winner fund guidance does not change the referral-code source, persistence, or required display of the mint number in the confirmation email.
Post-win guidance does not change the Chainlink VRF provider, on-chain selection behavior, fairness properties, or applicable draw set.
